Claim 1 (currently amended): (Currently amended) A method for treating an ocular condition, the method comprising: administering to the interior of an eye a composition comprising a therapeutically effective amount of a macromolecular anti-angiogenic component (MAAC) to a mammal suffering from an ocular condition, wherein the composition also comprises a viscosity inducing component in an amount effective to increase the viscosity of the composition to a viscosity at about 25°C of at least 10 cps at a shear rate of about 0.1/second, wherein said viscosity inducing component is injectable into the vitreous of a mammalian eye without permanently diminishing visual acuity.

Claim 2 (currently amended): (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said composition comprises a solution.

Claim 3 (currently amended): (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said composition comprises a gel.

Claim 4 (currently amended): (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said composition comprises a suspension.

Claim 5 (currently amended): (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein a symptom related to the ocular condition is angiogenesis and the MAAC comprises a direct or indirect inhibitor of vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) activity.

Claim 6 (original): (Original) The method of claim 5 wherein the MAAC comprises an agent selected from the group consisting of a nucleic acid (an oligonucleotide) and a polypeptide.

Claim 14 (original): (Original) The method of claim 6 wherein said MAAC comprises a protein.

Claim 15 (currently amended): (Currently amended) The method of claim 14 wherein said protein is an angiogenesis inhibitor selected from the group consisting of an antibody, an antibody mimic, and a receptor inhibitor.

Claim 20 (currently amended): (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component comprises a compound selected from the group consisting of a hyaluronic acid, a cross-linked hyaluronic acid, a crosslinked polymer containing subunits derived from acrylic acid, polyacrylic acid, celluloses derivatives, polycarbophil, polyvinylpyrrolidone, gelatin, dextrin, polysaccharides, polyacrylamide, polyvinyl alcohol, polyvinyl acetate, and derivatives, mixtures and copolymers thereof.

Claim 36 (currently amended): (Currently amended) A pharmaceutical composition for intravitreal administration to treat an ocular condition comprising a MAAC and a high viscosity hyaluronic acid carrier.
